description: Delivery vehicle broke down during transit while carrying a customer shipment.
resolution: Assigned a replacement vehicle to the shipment.

description: The delivery address provided for the customer shipment was incomplete and could not be verified.
resolution: Contacted the customer and confirmed the correct delivery address.
outcome: Shipment was delivered successfully after the address was corrected.

description: A customer shipment was delayed and missed its planned delivery window.
resolution: Rescheduled the delivery and assigned the shipment to the next available delivery route.
outcome: Shipment was delivered successfully on the rescheduled route.

description: A package was found damaged during the delivery process before reaching the customer.
resolution: Held the damaged package and arranged a replacement shipment.

description: The delivery attempt failed because the customer was unavailable at the delivery location.
resolution: Rescheduled the delivery for the customer's preferred time.
outcome: Shipment was delivered successfully on the second attempt.
